Jamie — thanks, outlined a draft MAP attached. High-level summary below and attached: Redwood-MAP_v1.xlsx.

Draft MAP (proposed):
- Week 1 (by 2026-03-28): POC infra & baseline test harness ready (owner: Marcus Lin)
- Week 2 (by 2026-04-02): Run evaluation suites, collect perf/quality metrics (owner: Priyom Das)
- Week 3 (by 2026-04-09): Security/compliance review complete (owner: Evelyn Hart)
- Procurement target: PO issued by 2026-04-08, SOW draft by 2026-04-01 (owner: Laura Bennett / Marcus to deliver SOW)
- Go/no-go decision: 2026-04-10 (executive sponsor alignment)

Evaluation criteria (short):
- 95th percentile latency under expected load: < 150ms
- Throughput: sustain 50 QPS for baseline workload
- Memory/kv-cache behavior stable across 128k-token sessions
- Quality: top-line pass rate on provided prompt set >= 88% (we'll map your eval sets into our harness)

Next steps: I propose a weekly 30-minute MAP checkpoint — same time each Thursday — to keep owners accountable. Please review the attached and flag any date conflicts.

Attachments: Redwood-MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP milestones + owners)

Best,
